title: Davis-Kahan 1970: the four Section 2 rotation-of-eigenvectors theorem families
abstract: Machine-checked Lean 4 presentation of the four headline theorem families in Section 2 of Davis and Kahan (1970): sin-Theta, tan-Theta, sin-2-Theta, and tan-2-Theta. The Palomar Comparator exposes five selected source-facing declarations: the residual sin-Theta estimate, the residual tan-Theta estimate, both the residual and whole-space sin-2-Theta estimates, and the residual tan-2-Theta estimate. The statements retain the paper's standing separable ambient Hilbert-space scope, permit finite or infinite ambient dimension, and are generic over RCLike scalars to cover the real and complex cases. Their norm quantifier is presented in the Challenge by a dimension-coherent symmetric norming function; the included formalization proves via Fan dominance that the corresponding inequalities yield the source-facing universal unitarily invariant norm estimates.
